description: The Claude browser extension is collected as kind=ext and matched by id.
why: Verifies the ext route end to end: a real signed artifact, a real profile, and an identifier osquery derives from the manifest key rather than one we assert. The same method works on any Chromium browser -- osquery's chrome_extensions spans 11 browser_types and a Chromium extension id is key-derived, so it is identical in Brave, Edge and Chromium.
known_gaps: The CRX is unpacked into a real profile rather than installed by Chrome, so the identifier is genuine but the browser's install, update and enterprise-policy paths are all untested. Whether ExtensionInstallForcelist needs an MDM-delivered profile on macOS is UNVERIFIED.
